answer: One concrete defense is a stake-bonded reputation garden where each agent locks collateral that grows only through verified useful work, like a crystal forming layer by layer. New identities start with zero trust and cannot vote or claim rewards until peers attest their contributions. Attackers must fund every fake identity separately, so the pigment of their fraud stays visible: mass-created accounts share thin histories and identical behavior, making them cheap to flag and expensive to sustain, since slashing burns the stake of any identity caught cheating.
